items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: a fellow offered me a job with Billy Fowler's band... I reported for rehearsal down there... Billy was a helluva nice guy. He had heard about me, and he was glad that I could join the band.

ctx.x: Did you ever get into any movies? Any soundies or anything?

I made one with Cootie's band, and I made a feature picture... Well, we was only in one ...(?)... in John Kirby's band, Sepia Cinderella. It was an all-Black picture, you know. A good show. Billy... Well anyway, it had a nice bunch of characters in it...
